column1: # Borland's own example programs and class library, from the Borland C++ 2.0 disks (installed by
# scripts/setup-toolchains.py; not in this repository).  tools/modtest.py compiles each one
# that is installed, with these switches, as -c and -S (or the steps given), with the file's
# own folder and CLASSLIB/INCLUDE on the include path.  Switches follow Borland's own build
# files where there are any (CLASSLIB/SOURCE/BUILD.BAT: -P; EXAMPLES/WIN/WHELLO.MAK: -ms -v -W).
